lines: d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Kofi Shao is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d42: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d42: 🕯️ Kofi is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d42: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d42: 🕯️ Kofi Shao is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d42: What Kofi kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d42: "Kofi's gone." Mia looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Kofi." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d42: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Finn blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Weather (Level 1). Red sky at night, shepherd's delight. Red sky at morning, shepherd's warning. It works.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Water (Level 1). You know where fish hold: seams, eddies, shade lines. The water stops being a surface and starts being a map.
d42: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Kofi Shao, 42 days. The mantle passes to Finn Niu.
d42: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Finn Niu, 48 — a fishing guide. Their hands know different work now: Night Eyes, Echo Location, Berserker Rage.
d42: The village's quarrel was with Kofi — and Kofi is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d42: At the grave, Mogamad, Eyram, Nino and 5 more speak for Finn — "Kofi trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d42: The fire knew Finn before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

d42: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d42: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)

lastSay: d111: 🌙 Raid — Ashford came in the night from the southwest. They trampled 2 garden plots into mud. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
d112: — DAY 112 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
d112: Something has shifted. Conversations stop when you approach the fire. Nobody meets your eyes for long.
d112: Riders from Emberhold: something's at THEIR door now. They can't spare anyone — and they wanted Haven to know first.
d112: Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. Your sleeping body burned less — 26 kcal conserved. By the fire. Good enough.)
